propositions: The completion verifier's schema-blind selection in tolerant_parse returns the first parseable JSON object instead of the first schema-valid one, causing it to extract dependency-link records quoted in prose before the actual verdict.

When show_ticket returns raw JSON including deps, and the verifier quotes a Dep record before its verdict, the Dep's key order matches tolerant_parse first-fence/first-object heuristics, triggering schema validation failure on CompletionVerdict.

The root cause is selection policy in tolerant_parse and _first_json_object, not wiring or context assembly, and is shared by all structured LLM gates (plan-review, code-review, completion, overlap, epic-bug-screen).

The fix requires schema-filtered candidate selection in parse_structured with last-valid-wins tiebreaker, schema-aware sentinel channel directive, and atomic delivery of directive+extraction to prevent compliance making failures more likely.
Candidate screening must key on model_cls.model_fields overlap to eliminate all-defaults-contract degeneration, with fallback to today's pipeline preserving caller safety and error attribution.
